verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

translations.ron: Fericit cel care caută la sărac şi la sărman; în ziua cea rea îl va izbăvi pe el Domnul.
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, ψαλμὸς τῷ Δαυίδ.

verses.translation: Blessed is the man who thinks on the poor and needy: the Lord shall deliver him in an evil day.

translations.ron: Domnul să-l păzească pe el şi să-l vieze şi să-l fericească pe pământ şi să nu-l dea în mâinile vrăjmaşilor lui.
translations.grk: Μακαρίος ὁ συνιῶν ἐπὶ πτωχὸν καὶ πένητα, ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πονηρᾷ ῥύσεται αὐτὸν ὁ Κύριος.

verses.translation: May the Lord preserve him and keep him alive, and bless him on the earth, and not deliver him into the hands of his enemy.

translations.ron: Domnul să-l ajute pe el pe patul durerii lui; în aşternutul bolii lui să-l întărească pe el.
translations.grk: Κύριος φυλάξαι αὐτὸν καὶ ζήσαι αὐτὸν, καὶ μακαρίσαι αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ γῇ, καὶ μὴ παραδοῖ αὐτὸν εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθροῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: May the Lord help him upon the bed of his pain; thou hast made all his bed in his sickness.

translations.ron: Eu am zis: "Doamne, miluieşte-mă; vindecă sufletul meu, că am greşit ţie".
translations.grk: Κύριος βοηθήσαι αὐτῷ ἐπὶ κλίνης ὀδύνης αὐτοῦ, ὅλην τὴν κοίτην αὐτοῦ ἔστρεψας ἐν τῇ ἀῤῥωστίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: I said, O Lord, have mercy upon me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

translations.ron: Vrăjmaşii mei m-au grăit de rău zicând: "Când va muri şi va pieri numele lui?"
translations.grk: Ἐγὼ εἶπα, Κύριε ἐλέησόν με, ἴασαι τὴν ψυχήν μου, ὅτι ἥμαρτόν σοι.

verses.translation: Mine enemies have spoken evil against me, saying, When shall he die, and his name perish?

translations.ron: Iar de venea cineva să mă vadă, minciuni grăia; inima lui aduna fărădelege sieşi, ieşea afară şi grăia.
translations.grk: Οἱ ἐχθροί μου εἶπαν κακά μοι, πότε ἀποθανεῖται καὶ ἀπολεῖται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ;

verses.translation: And if he came to see me, his heart spoke vainly; he gathered iniquity to himself; he went forth and spoke in like manner.

translations.ron: Împreună împotriva mea şopteau toţi vrăjmaşii mei; împotriva mea gândeau de mine rele.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἰ εἰσεπορεύετο τοῦ ἰδεῖν, μάτην ἐλάλει ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ, συνήγαγεν ἀνομίαν ἑαυτῷ, ἐξεπορεύετο ἔξω, καὶ ἐλάλει

verses.translation: All my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised my hurt.

translations.ron: Cuvânt nelegiuit spuneau împotriva mea, zicând: "Nu zace, oare? Nu se va mai scula!"
translations.grk: ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό. Κατʼ ἐμοῦ ἐψιθύριζον πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου, κατʼ ἐμοῦ ἐλογίζοντο κακά μοι.

verses.translation: They denounced a wicked word against me, saying, Now that he lies, shall he not rise up again?

translations.ron: Chiar omul cu care eram în pace, în care am nădăjduit, care a mâncat pâinea mea, a ridicat împotriva mea călcâiul.
translations.grk: Λόγον παράνομον κατέθεντο κατʼ ἐμοῦ, μὴ ὁ κοιμώμενος οὐχὶ προσθήσει τοῦ ἀναστῆναι;

verses.translation: For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, lifted up his heel against me.

translations.ron: Iar Tu, Doamne, miluieşte-mă şi mă scoală şi voi răsplăti lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ γὰρ ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς εἰρήνης μου ἐφʼ ὃν ἤλπισα, ὁ ἐσθίων ἄρτους μου ἐμεγάλυνεν ἐπʼ ἐμὲ πτερνισμόν.

verses.translation: But thou, O Lord, have compassion upon me, and raise me up, and I shall requite them.

translations.ron: Întru aceasta am cunoscut că m-ai voit, că nu se va bucura vrăjmaşul meu de mine.
translations.grk: Σὺ δὲ Κύριε ἐλέησόν με, καὶ ἀνάστησόν με, καὶ ἀνταποδώσω αὐτοῖς.

verses.translation: By this I know that thou hast delighted in me, because mine enemy shall not rejoice over me.

translations.ron: Iar pe mine pentru nerăutatea mea m-ai sprijinit şi m-ai întărit înaintea Ta, în veac.
translations.grk: Ἐν τούτῳ ἔγνων, ὅτι τεθέληκάς με ὅτι οὐ μὴ ἐπιχαρῇ ὁ ἐχθρός μου ἐπʼ ἐμέ.

verses.translation: But thou didst help me because of mine innocence, and hast established me before thee for ever.

translations.ron: Binecuvântat este Domnul Dumnezeul lui Israel din veac şi până în veac. Amin. Amin.
translations.grk: Ἐμοῦ δὲ διὰ τὴν ἀκακίαν ἀντελάβου, καὶ ἐβεβαίωσάς με ἐνώπιόν σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

verses.translation: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. So be it, so be it.

translations.grk: Εὐλογητὸς Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς Ἰσραὴλ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· γένοιτο, γένοιτο.
